tldr: 台股11月6日盤中暴跌3,737點創紀錄，終場跌1,873點（-4.51%）收39,701.64點、失守4萬點，為史上第四大收盤跌點。
三大法人賣超1,140億元，外資賣超912億、連21日減碼台積電與聯發科；投信逆勢買超266億元。
新台幣上演V型反轉，盤中破33元後，在央行調節與金管會限空令下終場升1.08角收32.768元。

items.title_zh: 台股盤中暴跌3,737點創紀錄，終場跌1,873點收39,701點失守4萬
items.title_en: TAIEX crashes a record intraday 3,737 points before closing down 1,873 at 39,701, losing the 40,000 mark (2026-11-06)
items.summary_zh: 加權指數11月6日盤中一度暴跌3,737.67點、創史上最大盤中跌點，最低殺至37,837.05點後急拉逾1,860點。終場仍重挫1,873.08點、跌幅4.51%，收39,701.64點，為史上第四大收盤跌點並跌破4萬點大關。成交量放大至約1.246兆元，恐慌殺盤與逢低買盤交戰，波動劇烈。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index plunged as much as 3,737.67 points intraday on Nov. 6 — its largest-ever intraday point drop — bottoming at 37,837.05 before a sharp recovery of more than 1,860 points. It still finished down 1,873.08 points, or 4.51%, at 39,701.64, the fourth-biggest closing point loss on record and a break below 40,000. Turnover swelled to about NT$1.246 trillion as panic selling met bargain hunting.

items.title_zh: 三大法人賣超1,140億，外資賣912億、投信逆勢買266億
items.title_en: Institutions dump NT$1,140 billion as foreigners sell NT$912 billion but trust funds buy the dip (2026-11-06)
items.summary_zh: 三大法人11月6日合計賣超1,140.06億元，其中外資及陸資賣超911.88億元、自營商賣超494.76億元，投信則逆勢買超266.58億元。外資賣超張數以中鋼30,305張、台積電22,844張（收2,135元）居前，並倒貨0050達88,714張；但資金逆勢回補面板雙虎群創、友達及債券ETF，顯示法人籌碼明顯分歧。
items.summary_en: The three major institutional groups sold a net NT$1,140.06 billion on Nov. 6. Foreign and mainland investors sold NT$91.19 billion, dealers NT$49.48 billion, while domestic investment trusts bought a net NT$26.66 billion against the trend. Foreigners offloaded the most China Steel (30,305 lots) and TSMC (22,844 lots, closing at NT$2,135) and dumped 88,714 lots of the 0050 ETF, but rotated into panel makers Innolux and AUO and a bond ETF.

items.title_zh: 外資連21日減碼台積電、聯發科，本週賣超台股5,244億元
items.title_en: Foreigners cut TSMC and MediaTek for a 21st straight session, pulling NT$524 billion from stocks this week (2026-11-06)
items.summary_zh: 外資11月6日對AI權值股台積電、聯發科的減碼已連續21個交易日，本週累計賣超台股達5,244億元。賣壓與全球晶片股重挫同步，衝擊今年領軍上攻的半導體供應鏈，凸顯AI交易在回檔前籌碼過度集中，外資調節尚未停歇，供應鏈後市承壓。
items.summary_en: Foreign investors extended their reduction of AI heavyweights TSMC and MediaTek to a 21st consecutive session on Nov. 6, with weekly net selling of Taiwan equities reaching NT$524.4 billion. The relentless outflow tracked the global sell-off in chip names, pressuring the semiconductor supply chain that has led the market's rally this year and underscoring how crowded the AI trade had become before the correction.

items.title_zh: 資金棄AI轉進面板、記憶體，0050遭倒貨近8.9萬張
items.title_en: Money rotates out of AI into panels and memory as 0050 ETF gets dumped (2026-11-06)
items.summary_zh: 外資11月6日賣超約911億元並倒貨0050 ETF近8.87萬張，卻逆勢掃貨面板雙虎群創、友達及記憶體相關個股。此一輪動顯示，在漲多的AI與權值晶片股遭獲利了結之際，資金轉向低基期、價值型族群尋找標的，指數重挫背後隱含產業板塊輪動的跡象。
items.summary_en: Even as foreigners sold a net NT$91.1 billion on Nov. 6 and offloaded nearly 88,700 lots of the 0050 ETF, they rotated into unloved sectors, buying panel twins Innolux and AUO and memory-related names. The shift suggests capital is hunting for laggards and value plays as the high-flying AI and heavyweight-chip trade unwinds, hinting at a possible sector rotation beneath the headline index plunge.

items.title_zh: 新台幣V型反轉，盤中破33元終場升1.08角收32.768元
items.title_en: Taiwan dollar stages a V-shaped reversal, closing up 1.08 cents at 32.768 after breaching 33 (2026-11-06)
items.summary_zh: 新台幣兌美元11月6日早盤摜破33元整數關卡、最低觸及約33.04元，股災引發資金外流壓力。午後在央行盤中強勢調節、金管會祭出限空令及出口商拋匯助攻下絕地反攻，終場升1.08角、收32.768元，終止連四日收黑；惟本週仍累計貶值約0.9%，匯市波動加劇。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan dollar fell through the 33-per-dollar level early on Nov. 6, hitting a low near 33.04 as the stock rout spurred capital outflows. It then roared back in the afternoon, helped by aggressive central-bank intervention, a short-selling restriction from the FSC, and exporters unloading US dollars, to close up 1.08 cents at 32.768 — ending a four-day losing streak, though it was still down 0.9% on the week.

items.title_zh: 富邦金羅瑋：2因素未解前，新台幣恐偏弱
items.title_en: Fubon's chief economist says the Taiwan dollar will stay weak until two factors clear (2026-11-06)
items.summary_zh: 富邦金首席經濟學家羅瑋表示，在外資持續匯出與美元、美國利率走向未明兩大因素未解前，新台幣料維持偏弱格局。此番談話適逢新台幣在33元關卡劇烈震盪之際，點出金融業短線風險——匯率與投資部位對本幣走貶及跨境資金劇烈進出相當敏感，後續須留意評價波動。
items.summary_en: Fubon Financial chief economist Lo Wei said the Taiwan dollar is likely to remain soft until two overhangs are resolved: persistent foreign equity outflows and uncertainty over the direction of US rates and the dollar. The comments, made as the currency whipsawed around the 33 level, frame the near-term risk for financial firms whose FX and investment books are sensitive to a weaker local currency and volatile cross-border flows.

items.title_zh: 台新私人銀行亞灣旗艦店開幕，攜手瑞士瑞聯銀行
items.title_en: Taishin opens Asia Bay private-banking flagship, partnering Switzerland's UBP (2026-10-23)
items.summary_zh: 台新銀行於高雄成立「台新私人銀行亞灣旗艦店」，並與瑞士瑞聯銀行（UBP）簽署策略合作備忘錄，打造國際級私人銀行服務。此舉鎖定台灣快速成長的高資產客群，強化海外資產配置、結構型商品與財富傳承布局，反映本國銀行競相搶進高資產財富管理市場的趨勢，推升私銀業務動能。
items.summary_en: Taishin Bank opened its "Asia Bay Private Banking Flagship" in Kaohsiung and signed a strategic cooperation MOU with Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) of Switzerland to build international-grade private-banking services. The move targets Taiwan's fast-growing pool of high-net-worth clients, deepening offshore asset-allocation, structured-product and succession capabilities as domestic banks race to capture the expanding high-asset wealth-management market.

items.title_zh: 台灣高資產財管規模創新高，銀行搶攻家族辦公室業務
items.title_en: Taiwan's high-asset wealth AUM hits a record as banks chase family-office business (2026)
items.summary_zh: 台灣高資產財富管理市場再創新高，金管會統計高資產AUM達約2.08兆元、年增逾50%，淨值過億的高資產人數同創歷史新高。銀行積極布局，凱基銀行推出「私人銀行會員」服務資產逾1億元客戶，並延伸至家族治理與傳承規劃，反映業者爭搶高資產客群、財管業務持續擴張的態勢，競爭日趨白熱化。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's high-asset wealth-management market has scaled new highs, with FSC data showing high-asset AUM reaching NT$2.08 trillion, up more than 50% year-on-year, and the number of individuals with net worth above NT$100 million at a record. Banks are responding: KBank's new "private-banking membership" serves clients with assets over NT$100 million, extending into family governance and succession planning as competition for wealthy clients intensifies.
